landing.faq.title: FAQ
landing.faq.a1: A platform for CTF competitions and cybersecurity practice: flag-checked challenges, isolated labs and a live scoreboard in one place. Created at Kharkiv National University of Radio Electronics (KhNURE), in the V. V. Popovskyi ICE Department.
landing.faq.a2: For participants — university students, school students who compete in olympiads, and teams from other institutions — and for organizers who run competitions and olympiads.
landing.faq.q3: Can I play solo, or only in a team?
landing.faq.a3: Both. The organizer picks an individual or a team format; in a team event you create a team or join one with a code.
landing.faq.q4: What kinds of challenges are there?
landing.faq.a4: Web, cryptography, binary exploitation, reverse engineering, forensics. Simple challenges are verified with a flag; more complex ones deploy their own infrastructure.

legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains what personal data is processed when you use the Cyber ICE Box platform (the "Platform"), for what purposes and on what legal bases, to whom it is disclosed, how long it is kept and what rights you have. It is prepared in accordance with the Law of Ukraine "On Personal Data Protection" and, for users in the European Union, the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
legal.privacy.s1.heading: Who processes your data
legal.privacy.s1.items.1: The controller of personal data is the Cyber ICE Box project team ("we", "us"). The team is an independent group of developers and is not registered as a legal entity.
legal.privacy.s1.items.2: The project is supported by the V. V. Popovskyi Department of Infocommunication Engineering of KhNURE. The University is neither a controller nor a processor of your personal data and does not operate the Platform.
legal.privacy.s1.items.3: Data that an event organizer collects through their event's registration form is processed to run that event. The organizer decides what information to request and for what purpose, and is responsible for the lawfulness of those requests.
legal.privacy.s1.items.4: For any question about personal data, write to {privacyEmail}.
legal.privacy.s2.heading: Data we process
legal.privacy.s2.items.1: Account data: first and last name, email address, password hash (the password itself is not stored), profile picture, role on the Platform, date of acceptance of the Terms and time of last activity. If you sign in with Google, we also store your Google account identifier and receive your name, email address and profile picture from Google.
legal.privacy.s2.items.2: Participation data: the events you take part in, teams and invitations, submitted answers and flags, points and leaderboard positions, and answers to event registration forms.
legal.privacy.s2.items.3: Technical data: IP address and browser data (user agent) in sign-in session records; lab access and VPN connection logs; technical telemetry from lab environments during events; email and notification delivery logs (recipient, message type, delivery status).
legal.privacy.s2.items.4: Cookies and similar technologies — see the [Cookie Policy](/cookies).
legal.privacy.s2.items.5: Correspondence: information you provide when you write to us.
legal.privacy.s2.after: We do not intentionally collect special categories of data (such as data about health or religious or political beliefs). Please do not include such data in forms or answers.
legal.privacy.s3.heading: Purposes and legal bases
legal.privacy.s3.items.1: Creating and maintaining your account, signing in, taking part in events, scoring and leaderboards, lab and VPN access, and service emails (email confirmation, password reset, invitations, event notifications) — to perform the Terms of Use concluded with you.
legal.privacy.s3.items.2: Platform security, prevention of abuse and cheating, incident investigation, protection of forms against automated requests (Google reCAPTCHA) and logging — on the basis of our legitimate interest in keeping the Platform secure and fair.
legal.privacy.s3.items.3: Visitor analytics (Google Analytics) — solely on the basis of your consent, which you may withdraw at any time.
legal.privacy.s3.items.4: Compliance with the law and with lawful requests from competent authorities — on the basis of a legal obligation, where one arises.
legal.privacy.s3.after: We do not sell personal data or use it for advertising.
legal.privacy.s4.heading: Who we share data with
legal.privacy.s4.body: We engage service providers who process data only to the extent needed for their service, and we disclose data in the following cases:
legal.privacy.s4.items.1: Google — sign-in with Google (Google Sign-In), protection of sign-in and sign-up forms (reCAPTCHA) and visitor analytics (Google Analytics, only with your consent).
legal.privacy.s4.items.2: Brevo and Amazon Web Services (Amazon SES) — solely as email relays (SMTP) for sending messages: recipient address, message content and delivery data.
legal.privacy.s4.items.3: Cloudflare — DNS, proxying and a secure tunnel to the Platform's servers, and forwarding of email sent to our addresses. The Platform's network traffic passes through Cloudflare.
legal.privacy.s4.items.4: The hosting provider — the servers that run the Platform, its databases, file storage and labs.
legal.privacy.s4.items.5: Event organizers — receive data about the participants of their event: name, email address, team, registration form answers and results. An organizer may connect their own mail server to an event, in which case that event's emails are sent through it.
legal.privacy.s4.items.6: Other participants — see your name or team name and results on the leaderboards of events you take part in.
legal.privacy.s4.items.7: Public authorities — only in the cases and in the manner provided by law.
legal.privacy.s5.heading: International transfers
legal.privacy.s5.body: Google, Cloudflare, Brevo and Amazon Web Services may process data outside Ukraine and the European Economic Area, including in the United States. Such transfers take place under these providers' data protection terms, which provide appropriate safeguards, such as the standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission or adequacy decisions. We transfer only the data needed for the service concerned.
legal.privacy.s6.heading: Retention
legal.privacy.s6.body: We keep data no longer than necessary for the purpose of processing:
legal.privacy.s6.items.1: Account — for as long as it is active. After a deletion request, account data is deleted within 30 days. Accounts inactive for more than 3 years are deleted after an email warning.
legal.privacy.s6.items.2: Sign-in sessions — expire after 30 days of inactivity; their records (IP address, user agent) are deleted no later than 90 days after the session ends.
legal.privacy.s6.items.3: Lab access and VPN logs and lab telemetry — 90 days.
legal.privacy.s6.items.4: Email and notification delivery logs — 180 days.
legal.privacy.s6.items.5: Registration form answers — until the event ends and for 1 year afterwards, after which they are deleted or anonymized.
legal.privacy.s6.items.6: Competition results (points, leaderboards) — kept as part of the event history. After an account is deleted, they are anonymized to preserve the integrity of the results.
legal.privacy.s6.items.7: Backups — up to 30 days, after which they are overwritten.
legal.privacy.s6.items.8: Cookies — see the [Cookie Policy](/cookies) for their lifetimes; your analytics choice is kept for 12 months. Google Analytics data is kept for 14 months.
legal.privacy.s6.after: Data may be kept longer only where required by law or where needed to investigate a specific incident or to establish or defend legal claims.
legal.privacy.s7.heading: Your rights
legal.privacy.s7.body: Under Article 8 of the Law of Ukraine "On Personal Data Protection" and, for users in the EU, the GDPR, you have the right to:
legal.privacy.s7.items.1: know what data about you is processed, for what purpose, by whom and to whom it is disclosed, and to access it;
legal.privacy.s7.items.2: request rectification of inaccurate or incomplete data;
legal.privacy.s7.items.3: request erasure of your data, including your account;
legal.privacy.s7.items.5: object to processing based on our legitimate interest;
legal.privacy.s7.items.6: receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format (data portability);
legal.privacy.s7.items.7: withdraw your consent to analytics at any time through "Cookie settings" in the site footer or account menu; withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out before it;
legal.privacy.s7.items.8: lodge a complaint with the Ukrainian Parliament Commissioner for Human Rights or, if you are in the EU, with the data protection supervisory authority in your country.
legal.privacy.s7.after: To exercise your rights, write to {privacyEmail} from the email address linked to your account. We will respond within 30 calendar days and may ask for additional information to verify your identity. You can change some of your data yourself in your profile.
legal.privacy.s8.heading: Children
legal.privacy.s8.items.1: The Platform may be used by school students, including participants in school olympiads and competitions.
legal.privacy.s8.items.2: If you are under 14 (for users in the EU, under the age set by the law of your country, which is at most 16), your data may be processed only with the consent of a parent or other legal guardian. The organizer of an event for minors is responsible for obtaining such consent.
legal.privacy.s8.items.3: If you believe we have received a child's data without the required consent, write to {privacyEmail} and we will delete it.
legal.privacy.s9.heading: Data security
legal.privacy.s9.items.1: Data is transmitted over encrypted channels (TLS; WireGuard for VPN). Passwords are stored only as cryptographic hashes, and VPN configurations are stored encrypted.
legal.privacy.s9.items.2: Only team members who need access to operate the Platform have it, with role-based access control.
legal.privacy.s9.items.3: Labs are isolated from the core infrastructure at network level; training targets contain no real personal data.
legal.privacy.s9.items.4: No method of protection guarantees absolute security. If a data breach puts your rights at risk, we will notify you and, where the law requires, the competent authority.
legal.privacy.s10.heading: Changes to this Policy
legal.privacy.s10.body: We may update this Policy. The date of the latest version is shown at the top of this page. We will announce material changes on the Platform or by email before they take effect.
legal.privacy.s11.heading: Contacts
legal.privacy.s11.body: Send questions about personal data and requests to exercise your rights to {privacyEmail}.

legal.terms.intro: These Terms of Use (the "Terms") govern access to and use of the Cyber ICE Box platform (the "Platform"), a cybersecurity training environment for lab work and CTF competitions.
legal.terms.s1.heading: Parties and acceptance
legal.terms.s1.items.1: The Platform is provided by the Cyber ICE Box project team ("we", "us"). The team is an independent group of developers and is not registered as a legal entity.
legal.terms.s1.items.2: The project is supported by the V. V. Popovskyi Department of Infocommunication Engineering of Kharkiv National University of Radio Electronics (KhNURE). The University is not a party to these Terms and does not provide the Platform.
legal.terms.s1.items.3: "User" or "you" means a person who visits the Platform or holds an account on it.
legal.terms.s1.items.4: By creating an account, taking part in an event or otherwise using the Platform, you confirm that you have read and agree to these Terms and the [Privacy Policy](/privacy). If you do not agree, do not use the Platform.
legal.terms.s1.items.5: If you are under 14, you may use the Platform only with the consent of a parent or other legal guardian. The organizer of an event for minors (for example, a school olympiad) is responsible for obtaining such consent.
legal.terms.s2.heading: Accounts
legal.terms.s2.items.1: An account is required to take part in events. You agree to provide accurate information and keep it up to date.
legal.terms.s2.items.2: Each person may hold only one account.
legal.terms.s2.items.3: You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for all actions taken through your account. Do not share your sign-in credentials with anyone.
legal.terms.s2.items.4: If you suspect unauthorized access to your account, change your password immediately and notify us at {privacyEmail}.
legal.terms.s2.items.5: You may stop using the Platform at any time and request deletion of your account as described in the [Privacy Policy](/privacy).
legal.terms.s3.heading: Acceptable use
legal.terms.s3.body: The Platform contains intentionally vulnerable systems and permits the use of offensive tools. This is allowed only within the following limits:
legal.terms.s3.items.1: Offensive tools and techniques may be used only against targets in the labs provided to you, and only while your access to them lasts.
legal.terms.s3.items.2: You must not attack, scan, overload or otherwise interfere with the Platform itself (its web applications, APIs, VPN gateways and infrastructure) or with other users' accounts and environments, unless a challenge explicitly requires it.
legal.terms.s3.items.3: You must not use the Platform, VPN access or lab infrastructure for any action against third parties or systems outside the labs, including unauthorized access, sending spam, cryptocurrency mining or hosting malicious content.
legal.terms.s3.items.4: Knowledge and tools gained on the Platform may be applied to real systems only with the written permission of their owners and in accordance with the law.
legal.terms.s3.items.5: You must not circumvent access restrictions, create accounts by automated means or use Platform resources beyond what a challenge requires.
legal.terms.s3.items.6: If you discover a vulnerability in the Platform itself (as opposed to a training target), do not exploit or disclose it; report it to {securityEmail} with a description and steps to reproduce. A good-faith report made in accordance with this clause is not a breach of these Terms.
legal.terms.s4.heading: Events and organizers' rules
legal.terms.s4.items.1: Events (competitions, training courses, olympiads) are created by organizers: teachers, educational institutions, communities and other persons whom we have enabled to do so.
legal.terms.s4.items.2: The organizer sets the rules of their event: its schedule, team composition, registration, scoring and awards. Event rules are binding on participants and supplement these Terms; in the event of a conflict, these Terms prevail.
legal.terms.s4.items.3: The organizer may request additional information at registration and is responsible for the content and lawfulness of such requests.
legal.terms.s4.items.4: We are not a party to arrangements between an organizer and participants (including those concerning prizes) and are not responsible for their performance.
legal.terms.s5.heading: Scoring and disqualification
legal.terms.s5.items.1: Points are awarded automatically under the event rules. Results may be recalculated in the event of a technical error, a change to a challenge or a detected violation.
legal.terms.s5.items.2: While an event is running, you must not: share or publish flags, solutions or hints; use other people's solutions; collude with other participants or teams; use multiple accounts; or interfere with other participants or with the scoring system.
legal.terms.s5.items.3: In the event of a violation, the organizer or we may cancel points, disqualify a participant or team, or restrict access to the event or to the Platform.
legal.terms.s5.items.4: A disqualification may be appealed: on matters of event rules, to the organizer; on actions taken by the Platform, at {privacyEmail}.
legal.terms.s5.items.5: The results of a completed event may remain available as part of its history.
legal.terms.s6.heading: User content
legal.terms.s6.items.1: User content is anything you submit to the Platform: answers and flags, solutions, reports, registration form answers, profile pictures, team names and the like.
legal.terms.s6.items.2: You retain your rights in your content. By submitting it, you grant us a free, non-exclusive licence to store, reproduce and display it to organizers and, as the event rules provide, to other participants, to the extent necessary to operate the Platform and run the event.
legal.terms.s6.items.3: You warrant that you are entitled to submit your content and that it does not violate the law or the rights of others. Offensive, discriminatory or unlawful content, and malicious code outside the scope of a challenge, are prohibited.
legal.terms.s6.items.4: We may remove content that violates these Terms.

legal.cookies.title: Cookie Policy
legal.cookies.intro: This Policy explains which cookies and similar technologies the websites of the Cyber ICE Box platform (the "Platform") use — the main site and the sign-in, event, administration and challenge catalogue sites — and how you can manage your choice. It supplements the [Privacy Policy](/privacy).
legal.cookies.s1.heading: What cookies are
legal.cookies.s1.body: Cookies are small text files that a website stores in your browser, for example to keep you signed in or to remember your settings. Browser local storage (localStorage) works in a similar way.
legal.cookies.s2.heading: Categories of cookies
legal.cookies.s2.items.1: Necessary — required for sign-in, security and remembering your settings. The Platform cannot work without them, so they are set without separate consent, on the basis of performing the Terms of Use and our legitimate interest in security.
legal.cookies.s2.items.2: Analytics — Google Analytics. Set only when you click "Accept all" or turn on "Analytics" in the cookie settings.
legal.cookies.s2.after: We do not use advertising cookies.
legal.cookies.s3.heading: List of cookies
legal.cookies.s3.rows.1.name: __Host-session
legal.cookies.s3.rows.2.name: oauth_state, oauth_intent, oauth_setup_token, oauth_link_sid, return_to
legal.cookies.s3.rows.2.duration: Up to 10 minutes or until the browser is closed
legal.cookies.s3.rows.3.name: cib_theme
legal.cookies.s3.rows.3.purpose: Your chosen theme: light, dark or system
legal.cookies.s3.rows.4.name: cib_consent
legal.cookies.s3.rows.5.name: _GRECAPTCHA
legal.cookies.s3.rows.5.purpose: Protects the sign-in, sign-up and password recovery forms against bots (reCAPTCHA)
legal.cookies.s3.rows.6.name: _ga
legal.cookies.s3.rows.7.name: _ga_<ID>
legal.cookies.s3.rows.7.purpose: Keeps the state of a visit in Google Analytics
legal.cookies.s3.after: Platform cookies apply to its domain and subdomains, so your choice and theme are the same on all of its sites. Browser local storage also holds technical interface settings (such as the sidebar state and the syncing of read notifications between tabs); these are not shared with third parties.
legal.cookies.s4.heading: Google Analytics and Consent Mode
legal.cookies.s4.items.1: We use Google Analytics with Google Consent Mode v2. Until you make a choice, all consent signals are set to "denied".
legal.cookies.s4.items.2: If you accept analytics, Google Analytics sets the _ga and _ga_<ID> cookies and collects data about the pages you visit, your device, browser and approximate location. Advertising signals always remain off.
legal.cookies.s4.items.3: If you decline analytics or have not yet made a choice, no analytics cookies are set. Google receives only cookieless signals (for example, that a page was viewed) that are not linked to an identifier in your browser.
legal.cookies.s4.items.4: Google Analytics data is processed by Google, including in the United States; see the [Privacy Policy](/privacy) for details.
legal.cookies.s5.heading: How to change your choice
legal.cookies.s5.items.1: Click "Cookie settings" in the site footer or account menu, turn "Analytics" on or off and click "Accept selected". "Accept all" and "Reject all" are available there too. Your choice applies to all Platform sites.
legal.cookies.s5.items.2: When you withdraw consent, we delete the Google Analytics cookies from your browser.
legal.cookies.s5.items.3: You can also delete or block cookies in your browser settings. If you block necessary cookies, signing in to the Platform will not work.
legal.cookies.s6.heading: Changes to this Policy
legal.cookies.s6.body: We update this Policy whenever the list of cookies changes. The date of the latest version is shown at the top of this page. Send any questions to {privacyEmail}.
